question: How do I add Google Analytics 4 tracking to my Fern Docs?
ground_truth: To add Google Analytics 4 tracking to your Fern Docs, open your docs.yml file and add your Google Analytics 4 property ID (in the format G-XXXXXXXXXX) under the analytics.ga4.measurement-id key. You can either hardcode the ID or use an environment variable. After configuration, it may take 24-48 hours for traffic data to appear in Google Analytics.

metadata.cited_context: Fern supports integrating with both Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. To integrate Google Analytics 4, ensure you have a property ID in the format G-XXXXXXXXXX. Open your docs.yml file and add your Google Analytics 4 property ID under the measurement-id key. Example configuration: analytics: ga4: measurement-id: G-12345678. You can optionally add the ID as an environment variable: analytics: ga4: measurement-id: ${{GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID}}. Verify data in Google Analytics. Note that it may take 24–48 hours for website traffic data to start appearing.
